name: Dredge
summary: The Dredge refers to coastal dredging rigs and mechanical barges operated in northern Kalimdor's waters. These industrial operations, typical of enterprising goblin engineering outfits like the Venture Company, focus on dredging seabeds and extracting materials from the coast.

sections.title: Industrial Encroachment
sections.body: Along the shores of Kalimdor, goblin-built dredges and harvesting platforms occasionally appear off the wild coasts. Utilizing crude pumps, heavy mechanical scaffolding, and industrial extraction tools, outfits such as the Venture Company deploy these rigs to sift coastal sands and extract raw materials. To the night elves guarding their ancestral forests, such machinery represents an invasive, polluting intrusion into nature's pristine waters.

faq.answer: It is a floating industrial platform or barge constructed with heavy goblin mechanics, designed to dredge coastal waters and extract resources from the seabed.
They are typical of goblin operations, notably unregulated commercial cartels like the Venture Company, who exploit natural waters without regard for local wilderness.

faq.q: Why do the night elves oppose them?
faq.answer: The night elves view industrial machinery and offshore drilling rigs as unnatural polluters that blight the pristine coastline and disrupt sacred waters.

angles.text: The mechanical clamor and polluting run-off of coastal dredging are an insult to the pristine waters of northern Kalimdor.
The massive iron framework and specialized pumping apparatus reflect heavy-duty goblin marine engineering.
